summary: Verified new NivXRay changes end-to-end. Backend: all 4 new /api/rc5/entities/* endpoints respond 200 with correct payloads (classify, classify-token, kinds, correlate). Correlate on empty graph returns ok:true with temporal_spans/dependency_chains/contradictions arrays and stats block. Frontend: admin login lands on Workspace; CorpusHealthPill renders next to wordmark with data-testid=corpus-health-pill showing 'CORPUS · 88/88' and data-gate=pass. All 7 primary nav tabs present (nav-workspace/dashboard/batch-test/heatmap/documents/benchmark/battery). BATTERY icon SVG is visually distinct from BENCHMARK Gauge icon (different <path> geometry). QuickOpenPalette opens on Ctrl+K (data-testid=quick-open-palette), on open it fires all 6 expected /api calls (investigations, admin/samples, training-inbox, batch/history, documents, mitre/heatmap), rows render with quick-open-row-* testids, Escape closes cleanly, typing filters. .nvx-btn buttons render with JetBrains Mono uppercase treatment (verified via computed style). Dashboard latency-trend-chart renders, Training Inbox filter tabs render, Documents/Benchmark heroes render (visual confirmation via screenshot). No blocking console errors on any route.

minor.issue: For text 'AssemblyVersion("9.0.0.0") and Connect("1.2.3.4", 443) plus 10.0.26100.1' the token 1.2.3.4 is classified as software_version (confidence 0.95) instead of ipv4, because the 'AssemblyVersion' keyword remains inside the token's context window. Test spec expected results to include an ipv4 classification. windows_build and software_version are correctly detected; ipv4 bucket ends up empty. Heuristic tuning may be needed (e.g., reset version-context after Connect/host-shaped call sites).

Returns 404 — endpoint does not exist in backend routers. QuickOpenPalette calls it as one of its 6 sources; it is caught by the palette's per-endpoint try/catch, but pollutes the console with a 404 network error every time the palette opens. Either add the endpoint or drop the call from QuickOpenPalette.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings when palette populates — flatResults key is `${kind}:${item.id || item._id || label}`; when items lack ids and share the same label (e.g., 8x TEST_upload.txt in documents, MITRE seed+heatmap merge), keys collide.

action_items: Tune entity_classifier so a version-context keyword does not leak across syntactic boundaries (e.g., reset after Connect/host/port cues) — so 1.2.3.4 inside Connect(...) classifies as ipv4.
Either add GET /api/training-inbox endpoint (backend) or remove the '/training-inbox?limit=200' call from QuickOpenPalette to eliminate the recurring 404.
Fix duplicate React key generation in QuickOpenPalette.flatResults by appending array index or hashing label+sub when id/_id are absent.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickOpenPalette gracefully degrades on 404 (per-endpoint try/catch) — good pattern, but the console noise from /api/training-inbox 404 should be resolved.
rc5_entities router correctly avoids DB writes and returns pure classifier output — verdict-neutral as documented.
Correlate endpoint validates payload via EvidenceGraph.model_validate and returns ok:false on bad input rather than 500 — nice defensive shape.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 new endpoints reachable and returning expected shape; 1 minor classification heuristic quirk)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested UI elements present, 1 duplicate-key React warning + 1 upstream 404)

seed_data_creation: None — 88 golden entries + 8 documents already seeded.

QuickOpenPalette (Ctrl+K) fires 6 backend calls on open; /api/training-inbox 404s (missing endpoint). Entity classifier context window is greedy — AssemblyVersion keyword still influences later tokens like 1.2.3.4. Benchmark/Admin page heroes may not use PageHeader component (no page-header testid on those routes) but do render titles.
rca of the issue: training-inbox 404: QuickOpenPalette.jsx line 131 calls api.get('/training-inbox?limit=200'), but no matching route exists in /app/backend/routers/. Available training routes are /admin/training-notes/sync-url and RSS pending.
